instructions: Which best describes what the `untrusted_record` reports?

options.label: randomised_trial
options.description: a trial in which the authors allocated participants to groups at random, with results

options.label: observational_study
options.description: original data from a cohort, case-control, cross-sectional, single-arm or non-randomised comparison study

options.label: systematic_review_or_meta_analysis
options.description: a structured search of the literature that pools or appraises studies by other authors

options.label: narrative_review
options.description: a summary of existing literature without a stated systematic search

options.label: modelling_or_simulation
options.description: results produced by a mathematical, economic or computer model rather than by observing participants

options.label: qualitative_study
options.description: interviews, focus groups or other non-numerical data on participants' experiences

options.label: case_report
options.description: a description of one patient or a handful of patients

options.label: protocol_without_results
options.description: the planned methods of a study that has not yet reported results

options.label: commentary_or_editorial
options.description: an opinion piece, letter or editorial that reports no new data

options.label: news_report_of_research
options.description: a journalist's report about research done by others

options.label: other
options.description: a kind of record none of the labels above describes

options.label: not_determinable
options.description: the record gives too little information to tell what it reports
